dataExposure.label: Page titles
dataExposure.detail: Page-visible titles are omitted because they can reveal private activity.

dataExposure.label: Hostnames
dataExposure.detail: Hostnames are replaced with stable local correlation hashes.

dataExposure.label: Filenames
dataExposure.detail: Runtime filenames and display names are omitted.

dataExposure.label: Full URLs
dataExposure.detail: Full page and media URLs are replaced with redacted summaries.

dataExposure.label: URL paths or hashes
dataExposure.detail: Only path hashes and safe extension hints are retained.

dataExposure.label: Query names
dataExposure.detail: Query-parameter names are omitted; only a count may remain.

dataExposure.label: Tokens or secret-shaped fields
dataExposure.detail: Secret-shaped fields, credentials, and token-like diagnostic text are redacted.

dataExposure.label: Queue history
dataExposure.detail: Current queue evidence is redacted; persisted queue history is privacy-reduced and bounded by retention settings.

dataExposure.label: Diagnostics
dataExposure.detail: Bounded local strategy outcomes, error categories, and self-test results are included.

dataExposure.label: Screenshots
dataExposure.detail: Screenshots are not generated or included.

dataExposure.label: Local paths
dataExposure.detail: Drive, user-profile, home, temporary, and network paths are redacted.

dataExposure.label: Browser or platform details
dataExposure.detail: The extension version, manifest permissions, user agent, platform, and language are included.

dataExposure.label: Blob identifiers
dataExposure.detail: Page-local blob identifiers are always redacted.

privacy.previewRetention: Extension-page memory only; invalidated when source evidence or report options change.
privacy.exportedZipRetention: Controlled by the browser, operating system, and user after export; delete manually when no longer needed.
privacy.note: Default mode omits titles and filenames, hashes host/path correlation values, and redacts full URLs, local paths, and secret-shaped fields.
